cargo-modules --acyclic reports inherent type-to-method self cycles even with --no-fns --no-types --no-owns, so it cannot directly verify module-only acyclicity; a module-scope cycle mode would prevent manual edge filtering
cargo-modules CLI did not support the expected --with-types/--visibility flags; a version-aware example in the dead-code workflow would prevent this dead end
apply_patch hunk failed after I mistyped the existing help text; showing the exact nearby lines in patch errors prevented a blind edit
